name: System A
description: US v5 stock engine + India v8 pieces + profit lock, chosen on 2012-2019
changes_vs_live_v5: universe: 500 most-traded US stocks (126-session median turnover)
India v8 buy pause instead of the v5 regime overlay; pause on HYG<SMA63, equal-weight large-cap index<SMA50, or breadth<30%
no -12% sleeve exit, no daily re-entry
decisions on the 11th and the last session of each month
also sell a holding ranked outside the top 45 (route RobustPair)
idle cash in the leading index ETF (SPY/QQQ/SMH by 126-session return), SHY while paused
profit lock: once up 30%, sell if it falls 25% below its peak close
no pullback-band entry gate; Recovery cutoff 0.95
